experiment_data.hypothesis: Scale verification: Pythia-1.4B T=15 α=0.60. At 410M, α=0.60 PermG=0/8 (sync-dip). Cross-T + cross-scale test: if 1.4B also 0/8 at T=15, sync-dip is both T-invariant and scale-invariant — a fundamental structural feature.
